page.overview:
What is Advanced Dungeons & Dragons?

Advanced Dungeons & Dragons belongs to Dungeons & Dragons. Dungeons & Dragons (abbreviated as D&D) is a paper-and-pencil role-playing game.

Gary Gygax and David Lance Arneson created Dungeons & Dragons in the year 1974. It was first published by Tactical Studies Rules, Incorporated. The game has been published by Wizards of the Coast since 1997.

Also known as: AD&D, Advanced D&D.
